verdict.rationale: Paxos is a stablecoin, brokerage and payments platform with a Dashboard, so in-product AI insights from a user's own data is a fair question. The pack shows no such feature. The only AI-related items are an AI assistant built into the documentation for API help, and llms.txt/llms-full.txt files for external AI tools. Both are adjacent developer aids, not AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from a user's platform data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
